title: rclpy Basics - Python Client Library for ROS 2
description: rclpy is the official Python client library for ROS 2, enabling developers to write ROS 2 nodes and interact with the ROS 2 ecosystem using Python. This chapter will introduce the fundamental concepts and basic usage of rclpy to get you started with building your first ROS 2 applications in Python.
